parsed.summary: After tracing every sheet against the specification, the build matches the intended design: the ESP32-C3 pin assignments (HEATER on GPIO1, SCK on GPIO5, SO on GPIO10, CS0/CS1/CS2 on GPIO4/6/7, USB D+/D- on GPIO19/18), the TPS1H200 heater switch (VS=+12V, IN/DIAG_EN=HEATER, CL/GND/EP=GND, FAULT=TP6), the TPS2121 mux (IN1=+12V, IN2=+5V, OUT=VBUS, ILIM=R12 51.1k, SS=C5 10nF, PR1/OV1/OV2/CP2/ST/GND=GND), the AP63203WU buck (IN/EN=VBUS, SW=L1 3.9uH+C13, FB=+3V3), the three MAX31855 channels with 1uF decoupling and shared SCK/SO plus independent CS, the USB-C 5.1k CC pulldowns, the reverse-biased D7 on +12V, the WS2812B, and all passive values are consistent with the spec. The only spec-silent items (extra clamp diodes D3/D4 on the fan-tach lines, the J5 screw terminal on the HEATER net, and a C3/C4/C6 reference permutation) are electrically harmless and do not constitute a deviation. No anomaly is supported by the drawing.
